headings.text: I study in Gulistan. I got into finance because I watched money, not ability, decide who stays in a classroom.
Three notes, each worth more than the last. Each one is a step from needing help to giving it.
I surveyed 54 students who get money from their parents. Why do some make it last while others run out and ask again?
The first idea in finance I learned: time does the heavy lifting. Move the sliders and watch one note grow.
Every certificate, score report and official letter, as issued. Tap one to read it.

findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 29% of the first screen is one empty block (1260×300px at 180,600).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 340px of the width empty: section#apply.sec.paper.
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 17 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
